entry.title: Bitcoin-rs: an independent Bitcoin full node written in Rust
entry.summary:
The integration of libbitcoinkernel into projects has generated mixed experiences among users. One notable issue encountered involves the header sync process, which appears to halt at height 0 when attempting to operate on the mainnet. This problem is detailed in a documented issue accessible via [GitHub](https://github.com/gosuda/bitcoin-rs/issues/1567), where further discussion and potential troubleshooting steps can be explored.
Feedback regarding the overall experience with libbitcoinkernel reveals areas of both satisfaction and difficulty. Users are encouraged to share their specific experiences, highlighting what aspects of libbitcoinkernel functioned effectively and identifying points of friction that could be improved. Such insights are invaluable for enhancing the utility and user-friendliness of libbitcoinkernel, and developers are actively seeking this feedback to refine the software further.
